title: Attachments: Policy review of CCCS' assembly line
body:
[Description as provided to ISTS](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1msKBjMAa3mGdDMTFvdkwZ8INz4Tf8kR9fURIUZEtZVI/edit#) below:

Document scanning
How do we stop malicious files from getting to our clients? Integration with CCCS’ assembly line is awesome, but what information is shared with CCCS and would it be a (unreasonable) breach of privacy? Need to work through these questions.

### Acceptance criteria:
- [x] Review the privacy implications of integrating with CCCS' assembly line for document scanning
- [x] Conduct an options analysis for file scanning
- [x] Policy provides a joint recommendation with ISTS on document scanning approach that meets privacy and security requirements (as defined by each group)
- [x] Document decision in a design document
author: Participant 1
scope: Current retrievable issue body and issue comments; not the original study's historical snapshot. Linked pages and attachments are not fetched.
